notes: Colour casts get a straighter answer. A yellow cast is now corrected like an orange one; "punch up the colour" and "turn up the saturation" work like "boost the colour". Asking to fix the white balance without saying which way now asks warmer or cooler instead of guessing. And a green or magenta cast is refused honestly — Crisp corrects blue to orange and has no green control, so nudging the warmth would change the picture without fixing what you asked about.
